Class BeansControlPanel

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.controlpanel.core.AbstractControlPanel<BeansControlPanel.Body>
io.micronaut.controlpanel.panels.management.beans.BeansControlPanel
All Implemented Interfaces:
ConfigurableControlPanel, ControlPanel<BeansControlPanel.Body>, io.micronaut.core.naming.Named, io.micronaut.core.order.Ordered, io.micronaut.core.util.Toggleable
@Singleton @Refreshable @Requires(beans=io.micronaut.management.endpoint.beans.BeansEndpoint.class) @Requires(property="micronaut.control-panel.panels.beans.enabled",notEquals="false") public class BeansControlPanel extends AbstractControlPanel<BeansControlPanel.Body>
Control panel that displays information about the beans loaded in the application.
